null_means: Not verified yet (Rule 6). Never render as free, never as 0.
note: Import Gate I4: no free text in a filtered field. A row whose fee_type is not one of these values fails I4. A venue can in reality offer several payment routes; this field records the LEAST RESTRICTIVE way a member of the public can play, using the precedence order below. Nuance belongs in pricing_notes, which is not a filtered field. The precedence rule is listed in decisions.md as an OPEN decision awaiting sign-off.

values.free: No charge of any kind to play: no fee, no membership, no reservation charge, no permit. This is the ONLY value that qualifies a venue for the /free/ filter page.
values.donation: No mandatory charge. A voluntary contribution is requested, or a donation box is present. Play is not refused for non-payment.
values.permit_required: Play requires a permit, pass or resident card issued by the operator, whether or not the permit itself costs money.
values.drop_in_fee: A per-session charge paid per visit. No ongoing membership is required to pay it.
values.reservation_fee: Courts are booked and paid for per reservation or per hour, including commercial court rental.
values.membership_required: Play requires an ongoing paid membership. Non-members cannot play, or may play only as a member's guest.
